result_text:
The three "latest orders" lists (overall, by region, by customer) now leave out archived orders as well as cancelled ones. The full `mvn -o test` run passes. I did not add a new test or run your SO-1 to SO-4 example on its own.

The change is in `SalesOrderQuery.latest(int)` in `DataStore.java`. It now adds the existing `NOT_ARCHIVED` condition, which the customer order list and open-order queries already use. Only those three lookups call `latest`, so nothing else is affected. I also updated the Javadoc on `latest` and on the three `findLatestSalesOrders*` methods to say archived orders are excluded.
